show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Karim Atiyeh - Building Ramp - [Invest Like the Best, EP.445]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Karim is the co-founder and CTO of Ramp, the fastest-growing finance automation platform in history.
reader_summary.overview: Karim is the co-founder and CTO of Ramp, the fastest-growing finance automation platform in history, reaching over $1 billion in revenue in just over five years. Ramp is, of course, also our presenting sponsor, so I’m obviously very biased in how highly I think about Ramp and about Karim. But, this interview was not part of that sponsorship, I simply view Karim as one of the best operators active today.

key_points.text: Ramp is building what Karim calls "self-driving finance"—using AI agents to automate everything from expense policy enforcement to invoice processing.
Karim shares his framework for moving from using AI as a productivity tool to programming AI as your actual product.
Our discussion captures the relentless iteration speed and technical depth required to build generational companies in the age of AI.
